ارتضخت (form VIII)

# اِرْتَضَخْتَ (irtaḍaḵta) /ir.ta.dˤax.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِرْتَضَخَ (irtaḍaḵa)
# اِرْتَضَخْتِ (irtaḍaḵti) /ir.ta.dˤax.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِرْتَضَخَ (irtaḍaḵa)
# اِرْتَضَخَتْ (irtaḍaḵat) /ir.ta.dˤa.xat/: third-p
